# React Native Background Location — Full API Reference

> Cross-platform React Native TurboModule library for background location tracking on Android and iOS.
> npm: @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-background-location
> Documentation: https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-background-location/

## Installation

```bash
yarn add @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-background-location
# or
npm install @gabriel-sisjr/react-native-background-location
```

Requirements: React Native >= 0.73.0, React >= 18.2.0, TurboModules enabled.
Expo (optional): SDK 54+ with a development build (Expo Go is not supported); add the config plugin, see https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-background-location/docs/guides/expo-config-plugin
Motion activity (optional, off by default): Android apps declare `android.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION` and `com.google.android.gms.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION` (`android:maxSdkVersion="28"`); iOS apps set `$BackgroundLocationMotionActivity = true` before the first `target` in the Podfile, run `pod install` and add `NSMotionUsageDescription`; Expo apps add the plugin prop `motionActivity: {}` (optional `usageDescription`). See https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-background-location/docs/guides/motion-activity
Google Play treats `ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION` as health-related sensitive data: show a prominent in-app disclosure and get the user's affirmative consent before `requestMotionPermission()`, complete the Health apps declaration in Play Console, and declare motion-derived data that leaves the device in the Data safety form under "Health and fitness > Fitness info". See https://gabriel-sisjr.github.io/react-native-background-location/docs/production/google-play-compliance

## Quick Start

```typescript
import {
  useBackgroundLocation,
  useLocationPermissions,
  LocationAccuracy,
} from '@gabriel-sisjr/react-native-background-location';

function TrackingScreen() {
  const { permissionStatus, requestPermissions } = useLocationPermissions();
  const { isTracking, startTracking, stopTracking, locations } = useBackgroundLocation();

  const handleStart = async () => {
    await requestPermissions();
    // The trip ID comes first; pass undefined to let the library generate one
    await startTracking('trip-1', {
      accuracy: LocationAccuracy.HIGH_ACCURACY,
      distanceFilter: 50,
      updateInterval: 5000,
    });
  };

  return (
    <View>
      <Text>Tracking: {isTracking ? 'Active' : 'Idle'}</Text>
      <Text>Locations: {locations.length}</Text>
      <Button
        title={isTracking ? 'Stop' : 'Start'}
        onPress={isTracking ? stopTracking : handleStart}
      />
    </View>
  );
}
```

## Tracking Functions

### startTracking

```typescript
function startTracking(options?: TrackingOptions): Promise<string>;
function startTracking(tripId: string, options?: TrackingOptions): Promise<string>;
```

Starts background location tracking. Returns the trip ID (auto-generated UUID if not provided).

Parameters:
- `tripId` (optional string) — Custom trip identifier. If omitted, a UUID is auto-generated. It is always the first argument: a `tripId` key inside the options object is ignored.
- `options` (optional TrackingOptions) — Tracking configuration.

Never prompts for the motion permission and never rejects because of motion activity: problems are reported as `MOTION_*` warnings and tracking continues at full accuracy.

### stopTracking

```typescript
function stopTracking(): Promise<void>;
```

Stops tracking and terminates the background service.

### isTracking

```typescript
function isTracking(): Promise<TrackingStatus>;
```

Returns `{ active: boolean; tripId?: string }`. Use to detect recovered sessions after crash.

### getLocations

```typescript
function getLocations(tripId: string): Promise<Coords[]>;
```

Retrieves all stored locations for the given trip ID from persistent storage (Room DB on Android, Core Data on iOS).

### clearTrip

```typescript
function clearTrip(tripId: string): Promise<void>;
```

Deletes all stored location data for the given trip ID.

### updateNotification

```typescript
function updateNotification(title: string, text: string): Promise<void>;
```

Updates the Android foreground service notification while tracking is active. No-op on iOS. While motion activity has reduced location updates, the title changes at once and the new text is shown when full accuracy is restored.

## Motion Activity Functions

Opt-in, enabled per session with `TrackingOptions.motionActivity`. Each function warns and returns a fallback when the native module is not available.

### addMotionActivityListener

```typescript
function addMotionActivityListener(listener: MotionActivityListener): MotionActivitySubscription;
```

Subscribes to `onMotionActivity` events (`MotionActivityEvent`). Returns `{ remove(): void }`. Events arrive only while a session with `motionActivity` enabled runs; consecutive events never repeat the same activity and confidence.

### checkMotionPermission

```typescript
function checkMotionPermission(): Promise<MotionPermissionStatus>;
```

Never prompts. Android: `GRANTED`, `DENIED`, or `UNAVAILABLE` without Google Play services (API 29+ checks `ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION`, API 28 and lower the Play services permission). iOS: `GRANTED`, `DENIED`, `UNDETERMINED`, or `UNAVAILABLE` (CoreMotion not compiled in, `NSMotionUsageDescription` missing or blank, no motion hardware).

### requestMotionPermission

```typescript
function requestMotionPermission(): Promise<MotionPermissionStatus>;
```

Call before `startTracking` (tracking never prompts; a permission granted mid-trip takes effect at the next start), and on Google Play only after the user accepted your motion disclosure. Android API 29+: system dialog through `PermissionsAndroid` (`GRANTED` or `DENIED`); API 28 and lower: current status (install-time permission). iOS: Motion & Fitness prompt while undetermined, app in the foreground; resolves `UNDETERMINED` when the user has not answered (for example, called while the app is not active).

### getMotionActivityState

```typescript
function getMotionActivityState(): Promise<MotionActivityState>;
```

Returns `{ tripId, detection, reduction, lastActivity }`. Without a session: `{ tripId: null, detection: OFF, reduction: DISABLED, lastActivity: null }`.

```typescript
function addGeofence(region: GeofenceRegion): Promise<void>;

```


```typescript
function removeAllGeofences(): Promise<void>;
```

```typescript
function getActiveGeofences(): Promise<GeofenceRegion[]>;
```

### getMaxGeofences

```typescript
function getMaxGeofences(): Promise<number>;
```

Returns platform limit: 100 on Android, 20 on iOS.

### getGeofenceTransitions

```typescript
function getGeofenceTransitions(identifier?: string): Promise<GeofenceTransitionEvent[]>;
```

### clearGeofenceTransitions

```typescript
function clearGeofenceTransitions(identifier?: string): Promise<void>;
```

### configureGeofenceNotifications

```typescript
function configureGeofenceNotifications(options: NotificationOptions): Promise<void>;
```

### getGeofenceNotificationConfig

```typescript
function getGeofenceNotificationConfig(): Promise<NotificationOptions | null>;
```

## React Hooks

### useBackgroundLocation

```typescript
function useBackgroundLocation(options?: UseLocationTrackingOptions): UseBackgroundLocationResult;
```

Full tracking control with trip and location management.

Options: `{ autoStart?, tripId?, options?, onTrackingStart?, onTrackingStop?, onError? }`

Returns: `{ tripId, isTracking, locations, isLoading, error, startTracking(), stopTracking(), refreshLocations(), clearCurrentTrip(), clearError() }`

### useLocationTracking

```typescript
function useLocationTracking(options?: UseLocationTrackingOptions): UseLocationTrackingResult;
```

Lightweight read-only tracking status. Returns: `{ isTracking, tripId, refresh(), isLoading }`

### useLocationUpdates

```typescript
function useLocationUpdates(options?: UseLocationUpdatesOptions): UseLocationUpdatesResult;
```

Real-time location event stream via NativeEventEmitter.

Options: `{ tripId?, onLocationUpdate?, onUpdateInterval?, onLocationWarning?, onNotificationAction?, autoLoad? }`

Returns: `{ tripId, isTracking, locations, lastLocation, lastWarning, isLoading, error, clearError(), clearLocations(), refreshLocations() }`

### useLocationPermissions

```typescript
function useLocationPermissions(): UseLocationPermissionsResult;
```

Cross-platform permission flow. Handles Android foreground → background → notification sequence and iOS WhenInUse → Always escalation.

Returns: `{ permissionStatus: PermissionState, requestPermissions(), checkPermissions(), isRequesting }`

### useGeofencing

```typescript
function useGeofencing(options?: UseGeofencingOptions): UseGeofencingReturn;
```

Geofence CRUD operations. Returns: `{ geofences, isLoading, error, addGeofence(), addGeofences(), removeGeofence(), removeGeofences(), removeAllGeofences(), maxGeofences, refresh() }`

### useGeofenceEvents

```typescript
function useGeofenceEvents(options?: UseGeofenceEventsOptions): void;
```

Real-time geofence transition listener. Options: `{ onTransition, transitionTypes?, geofenceId? }`

### useMotionActivity

```typescript
function useMotionActivity(options?: UseMotionActivityOptions): UseMotionActivityResult;
```

Read-only motion activity observer (never starts detection or prompts). Options: `{ tripId?, onMotionActivity? }`. Returns: `{ lastActivity, detection, reduction, refresh() }`. Hydrates through `getMotionActivityState()` on mount, on `tripId` change, when the app becomes active, on every `MOTION_*` warning, and on the first `onMotionActivity` event of a trip whose last-read state is not `RUNNING` (at most once per trip). A stop emits no event or warning: call `refresh()` after `stopTracking()`. With a native build that predates motion activity, it skips the automatic reads and logs `[BackgroundLocation] motion activity is not available in this native build; rebuild the app to use it.` once per JS session.

## Types

### TrackingOptions
```typescript
interface TrackingOptions {
  updateInterval?: number;       // ms between updates (default: 5000, Android)
  fastestInterval?: number;      // min ms between updates (Android)
  maxWaitTime?: number;          // max ms to batch updates (Android)
  accuracy?: LocationAccuracy;   // default: HIGH_ACCURACY
  activityType?: LocationActivityType; // iOS CLLocationManager hint, default: OTHER
  waitForAccurateLocation?: boolean;   // Android
  distanceFilter?: number;       // meters, 0 = disabled (Android and iOS)
  foregroundOnly?: boolean;      // no background permission needed (Android and iOS)
  onUpdateInterval?: number;     // ms throttle for hook callbacks
  notificationOptions?: NotificationOptions;
  motionActivity?: boolean | MotionActivityOptions; // opt-in, default: off
}
```

### MotionActivityOptions / MotionReductionOptions
```typescript
interface MotionActivityOptions {
  sampleInterval?: number;       // Android only, ms, default 30000, clamped to [10000, 300000]
  reduceWhenStationary?: boolean | MotionReductionOptions; // default: off; true = defaults
}

interface MotionReductionOptions {
  stationaryDelay?: number;      // ms, default 300000, clamped to [60000, 3600000]
  automotiveCooldown?: number;   // ms, default 600000, clamped to [120000, 3600000]
  maxReducedDuration?: number;   // ms, default 1800000, clamped to [300000, 3600000]
  notificationText?: string;     // Android only, default 'Location updates reduced while stationary'
}
```

The reduction degrades (never stops) location updates while the device is stationary: Android `PRIORITY_LOW_POWER` (60 s interval), iOS 3 km accuracy with a 500 m distance filter. It starts only after `stationaryDelay` of high-confidence STATIONARY and `automotiveCooldown` without vehicle evidence (also counted from the session start); keep-alive fixes are never stored or emitted; one full-accuracy fix is forced every `maxReducedDuration`; movement, vehicle evidence, displacement, detection loss and Android service restarts restore full accuracy, and every session (including a recovered one) starts at full accuracy. Not applied to `foregroundOnly` trips or `PASSIVE`/`NO_POWER` accuracy. Displacement means the keep-alive fix is farther from the anchor than max(100 m, the sum of both accuracies), where a full-accuracy fix counts with its accuracy plus the trip's distance filter. Android timers are inexact allow-while-idle alarms: up to about 75% late outside Doze (defaults: stationary delay up to about 8.75 min, cooldown 17.5, max reduced 52.5, probe 3.5), later in Doze; a timer that cannot be armed ends detection for the session (full accuracy, one `MOTION_ACTIVITY_UNAVAILABLE`: `Motion activity could not start (AlarmManager). Location tracking continues at full accuracy.`). iOS max-reduced and probe timers follow wall-clock time. The defaults are the recommended fleet settings.

### MotionActivityEvent / MotionActivityState
```typescript
interface MotionActivityEvent {
  tripId: string;
  activity: MotionActivityType;
  confidence: MotionConfidence;
  timestamp: number;             // ms since epoch, time of the detection
}

interface MotionActivityState {
  tripId: string | null;
  detection: MotionDetectionStatus;
  reduction: MotionReductionStatus;
  lastActivity: MotionActivityEvent | null;
}
```

### LocationWarningEvent
```typescript
type LocationWarningType =
  | 'SERVICE_TIMEOUT' | 'TASK_REMOVED' | 'LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE'
  | 'LOCATION_UPDATES_PAUSED' | 'LOCATION_UPDATES_RESUMED'   // iOS
  | 'PERMISSION_REVOKED' | 'PERMISSION_DOWNGRADED'           // iOS
  | 'MOTION_LOCATION_REDUCED' | 'MOTION_LOCATION_RESTORED'
  | 'MOTION_ACTIVITY_UNAVAILABLE' | 'MOTION_PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED';

interface LocationWarningEvent {
  tripId: string;
  type: LocationWarningType;
  message: string;
  timestamp: number;             // ms since epoch, sent on both platforms for every warning
}
```

New members may be added in minor releases: keep a `default` branch in exhaustive switches.

### Coords
```typescript
interface Coords {
  latitude: string;
  longitude: string;
  timestamp: number;
  accuracy?: number;
  altitude?: number;
  altitudeAccuracy?: number;
  speed?: number;
  speedAccuracy?: number;
  bearing?: number;
  bearingAccuracy?: number;
  elapsedRealtimeNanos?: number;
  provider?: string;
  isMocked?: boolean;
}
```

### GeofenceRegion
```typescript
interface GeofenceRegion {
  identifier: string;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  radius: number;                    // meters
  transitionTypes?: GeofenceTransitionType[];
  loiteringDelay?: number;           // ms for DWELL
  expirationDuration?: number;       // ms, -1 = no expiration
  metadata?: string;                 // JSON string
  notificationOptions?: NotificationOptions;
}
```

### NotificationOptions
```typescript
interface NotificationOptions {
  enabled?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  text?: string;
  channelId?: string;
  channelName?: string;
  priority?: NotificationPriority;
  smallIcon?: string;
  largeIcon?: string;
  color?: string;
  showTimestamp?: boolean;
  subtext?: string;
  actions?: NotificationAction[];
  transitionOverrides?: Partial<Record<
    'ENTER' | 'EXIT' | 'DWELL',
    Omit<NotificationOptions, 'transitionOverrides' | 'enabled'>
  >>;
}
```

## Enums

### LocationAccuracy
- `HIGH_ACCURACY` — GPS, ~10m accuracy
- `BALANCED_POWER_ACCURACY` — WiFi/Cell, ~100m
- `LOW_POWER` — Cell tower, ~1km
- `NO_POWER` — Passive, no extra power
- `PASSIVE` — Uses other apps' requests

### NotificationPriority
- `LOW`, `DEFAULT`, `HIGH`, `MAX`

### LocationPermissionStatus
- `GRANTED` — Full (Always) permission
- `WHEN_IN_USE` — Foreground only
- `DENIED` — User denied
- `BLOCKED` — Permanently denied
- `UNDETERMINED` — Not yet requested

### NotificationPermissionStatus
- `GRANTED`, `DENIED`, `UNDETERMINED`

### GeofenceTransitionType
- `ENTER`, `EXIT`, `DWELL`

### GeofenceErrorCode
- `INVALID_REGION`, `DUPLICATE_IDENTIFIER`, `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `MONITORING_FAILED`, `NOT_AVAILABLE`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `PLAY_SERVICES_UNAVAILABLE`

### MotionActivityType
- `STATIONARY`, `WALKING`, `RUNNING`, `CYCLING`, `AUTOMOTIVE`, `UNKNOWN` (unrelated to `LocationActivityType`; on iOS a car at a red light is `AUTOMOTIVE`)

### MotionConfidence
- `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH` (Android: below 50, 50-74, 75 and above; transitions are `HIGH`)

### MotionPermissionStatus
- `GRANTED` (`'granted'`), `DENIED` (`'denied'`), `UNDETERMINED` (`'undetermined'`, iOS only), `UNAVAILABLE` (`'unavailable'`)

### MotionDetectionStatus
- `OFF`, `RUNNING`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED`

### MotionReductionStatus
- `DISABLED`, `NOT_APPLICABLE` (`foregroundOnly` or `PASSIVE`/`NO_POWER`), `UNAVAILABLE`, `MONITORING`, `REDUCED`

## Platform Support

| Feature | Android | iOS |
|---------|---------|-----|
| Background tracking | Foreground service | CLLocationManager |
| Persistence | Room DB (schema v2, additive migrations) | Core Data |
| Motion activity (opt-in) | Activity Recognition API (Google Play services) | CoreMotion, compiled in only with the Podfile flag |
| Geofencing | GeofencingClient (100 max) | CLLocationManager (20 max) |
| Notifications | Full customization | System blue bar |
| Crash recovery | WorkManager | Significant location monitoring |
| Permission model | Foreground → Background → Notification | WhenInUse → Always |
| Min SDK | 24 | iOS 16 |
